pipeline.verdict: The real pipeline completed and all five numeric ratings and justifications are grounded in public speech. The four targeted trait contrasts survive biography generation, but the five adult answers are still only 2 or 3 (four 3s and one 2). Coverage alone is not a demonstrated response-compression fix. The panel was deliberately contrast-selected and cannot estimate a population mean or establish improvement over the earlier 50-person survey.
pipeline.generator_json_mode: Production JSON-object mode verified for all six biographies.
pipeline.normalization: All generated fields are retained unchanged; TinyPerson adds its default country_of_residence=None field.
pipeline.quality_settings: Original gazpacho threshold 5, up to 5 attempts, regeneration enabled, explicit reasoning step disabled.

costs.scope: Baseline and first coverage candidate: 2 returned plans
Self-audit revision: 1 invalid returned plan after timeout
Six-person actual generation/survey/extraction screen: 45 returned responses

cost_basis: 49 saved returned responses at saved Luna list rates. The unreturned timeout cost is unknown and excluded. Not an invoice or project-wide spending.
limitations: One returned plan per condition; 100 sampling seeds are not 100 independent model plans.
The compact condition changes representation and necessary format instructions relative to the second candidate, not its semantic requirements or input population.
The retry omitted explicit stream=False in its saved key; the API default is nonstreaming. All other non-message options match the baseline.
Numeric age compatibility and the four targeted contrasts are audited; no exhaustive joint-distribution or all-field persona-compliance claim is made.
Behavioral singleton quotas are illustrative coverage, not measured prevalence. The supplied demographic file is explicitly GPT-4o-synthesized.
No additional full notebook rollout or core suite was run in this follow-up, and no production source changed. The previous 434-core source fingerprint remains the production lineage.
Compact visible output was shorter in this comparison, but total completion usage was higher because of reasoning tokens; no cost or latency improvement is established.
No candidate was adopted based on obtaining a higher score. Overall empirical quality remains unresolved.
